# Executive Summary & Workflow Architecture

This R Markdown workbook implements a rigorous transcriptomics analytical pipeline for the Sepsis Transcriptomics Workshop dataset (`GSE152840`). The pipeline leverages **MultiScholaR** logic primitives to achieve:

1. **Proper CPM-based filtering** of low-expression genes via `edgeR::filterByExpr` and variance hygiene.
2. **Systematic parameter optimization** via grid search over negative control candidate percentages ($5\% - 30\%$) and factor dimensions ($k$), scored using Canonical Correlation Analysis (CCA) separation and an adaptive penalty.
3. **RUVSeq normalization** using the `RUVs` function across biological replicate groups, dynamically injecting the optimal number of unwanted variation covariates ($W_1, \dots, W_k$) into the linear model.
4. **Differential expression analysis** under edgeR's quasi-likelihood (QL) framework testing the contrast `Sera_vs_RPMI = groupSera - groupRPMI`.
5. **RUVIII normalization** producing batch-adjusted expression matrices (`transcriptomics_normalized_data.tsv`) formatted specifically for downstream multi-omics integration (e.g., MOFA2 / DIABLO).
6. **Publication-quality visual diagnostics**, including multi-panel CCA curves, 6-panel normalization progression grids (PCA/RLE), volcano plots, summary barplots, and interactive Glimma HTML explorers.

# Data Ingestion & Experimental Design

```{r load-data}
# 1. Ingest raw gene count matrix
counts_file <- file.path(data_dir, "GSE152840_gene_counts.txt")
if (!file.exists(counts_file)) {
  stop("Gene counts file not found at: ", counts_file)
}
counts_df <- vroom::vroom(counts_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

# 2. Ingest experimental design matrix
design_file <- file.path(source_dir, "design_matrix.tab")
if (!file.exists(design_file)) {
  # Auto-generate design matrix if not yet on disk
  sample_cols <- colnames(counts_df)[-(1:2)]
  design_matrix <- tibble::tibble(
    Run = sample_cols,
    group = rep(c("RPMI", "Sera"), each = 6),
    replicates = rep(1:6, 2)
  )
  vroom::vroom_write(design_matrix, design_file)
  vroom::vroom_write(design_matrix, file.path(data_dir, "design_matrix.tab"))
} else {
  design_matrix <- vroom::vroom(design_file, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      Run = as.character(Run),
      group = factor(group, levels = c("RPMI", "Sera"))
    )
}

# 3. Extract feature metadata and matrix
feature_meta <- counts_df |>
  dplyr::select(GeneID, GeneName) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    GeneName = ifelse(is.na(GeneName) | GeneName == "", GeneID, GeneName)
  )

count_matrix <- as.matrix(counts_df[, -(1:2)])
rownames(count_matrix) <- counts_df$GeneID
count_matrix <- count_matrix[, design_matrix$Run]

cat(sprintf("Loaded count matrix: %d genes across %d samples.\n", nrow(count_matrix), ncol(count_matrix)))
print(knitr::kable(design_matrix, caption = "Experimental Design Matrix"))
```

---

# Low-Expression Filtering via CPM (`filterByExpr`)

We apply standard statistical filtering to remove genes that fail to achieve reliable count levels across replicates. We subsequently eliminate features with zero sample variance.

```{r cpm-filtering}
# Create preliminary DGEList
dge_raw <- DGEList(counts = count_matrix, group = design_matrix$group)
dge_raw <- calcNormFactors(dge_raw, method = "TMM")

# Filter by expression across biological groups
keep_expr <- edgeR::filterByExpr(dge_raw, group = design_matrix$group)
count_matrix_filtered <- count_matrix[keep_expr, ]

# Filter zero variance features
gene_vars <- apply(count_matrix_filtered, 1, var)
count_matrix_filtered <- count_matrix_filtered[gene_vars > 0, ]

# Finalize filtered DGEList with recomputed TMM factors
dge_filtered <- DGEList(counts = count_matrix_filtered, group = design_matrix$group)
dge_filtered <- calcNormFactors(dge_filtered, method = "TMM")
log_cpm_tmm <- cpm(dge_filtered, log = TRUE)

cat(sprintf("Filtering complete: %d genes retained out of %d (%.2f%%).\n",
            nrow(count_matrix_filtered), nrow(count_matrix),
            100 * nrow(count_matrix_filtered) / nrow(count_matrix)))
```

---

# MultiScholaR RUV Parameter Optimization (Grid Search)

We systematically identify the optimal percentage of in silico negative controls and the optimal factor dimension ($k$). Candidates are ranked by least significance (highest $p$-value / lowest $F$-statistic) in a preliminary group-level GLM.

```{r ruv-grid-search}
# MultiScholaR helper primitives for Canonical Correlation Analysis (CCA)
find_best_k <- function(cancor_p, max_k = 3L) {
  df <- cancor_p$data
  if (!is.null(max_k)) {
    df <- df[df$K <= max_k, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  all_data <- df[df$featureset == "All", ]
  ctrl_data <- df[df$featureset == "Control", ]
  common_k <- intersect(all_data$K, ctrl_data$K)
  if (length(common_k) == 0) return(1L)
  diffs <- all_data$cc[match(common_k, all_data$K)] - ctrl_data$cc[match(common_k, ctrl_data$K)]
  valid_diffs <- diffs[is.finite(diffs)]
  if (length(valid_diffs) == 0) return(1L)
  max_diff <- max(valid_diffs, na.rm = TRUE)
  best_idx <- which(diffs == max_diff)
  as.integer(common_k[best_idx[1]])
}

calc_separation_score <- function(cancor_p, metric = "max_difference", max_k = 3L) {
  df <- cancor_p$data
  if (!is.null(max_k)) {
    df <- df[df$K <= max_k, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  all_data <- df[df$featureset == "All", ]
  ctrl_data <- df[df$featureset == "Control", ]
  common_k <- intersect(all_data$K, ctrl_data$K)
  if (length(common_k) == 0) return(0)
  diffs <- all_data$cc[match(common_k, all_data$K)] - ctrl_data$cc[match(common_k, ctrl_data$K)]
  valid_diffs <- diffs[is.finite(diffs)]
  if (length(valid_diffs) == 0) return(0)
  switch(metric,
    "max_difference" = max(valid_diffs, na.rm = TRUE),
    "mean_difference" = mean(valid_diffs, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(valid_diffs, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

# Preliminary GLM to rank negative controls by least significance
design_prelim <- model.matrix(~ group, data = design_matrix)
dge_prelim <- estimateDisp(dge_filtered, design_prelim)
fit_prelim <- glmQLFit(dge_prelim, design_prelim)
lrt_prelim <- glmQLFTest(fit_prelim, coef = 2)
tt_prelim <- topTags(lrt_prelim, n = nrow(dge_filtered), sort.by = "none")$table
ordered_features_idx <- order(tt_prelim$PValue, decreasing = TRUE)

# Optimization parameters
total_features <- nrow(log_cpm_tmm)
X_bio <- design_prelim[, -1, drop = FALSE]
max_acceptable_k <- if (ncol(count_matrix) < 15) 3L else 4L
k_penalty_weight <- 0.05
percentage_range <- seq(5, 30, by = 5)

# Grid search across negative control percentages
grid_results <- purrr::map(percentage_range, function(pct) {
  n_ctrl <- max(10, floor(total_features * (pct / 100)))
  ctl_idx <- rep(FALSE, total_features)
  ctl_idx[ordered_features_idx[seq_len(n_ctrl)]] <- TRUE

  cancor_p <- tryCatch({
    ruv::ruv_cancorplot(Y = t(log_cpm_tmm), X = X_bio, ctl = ctl_idx)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)

  if (is.null(cancor_p) || is.null(cancor_p$data)) return(NULL)

  best_k <- find_best_k(cancor_p, max_k = max_acceptable_k)
  sep_score <- calc_separation_score(cancor_p, "max_difference", max_k = max_acceptable_k)
  
  if (best_k <= max_acceptable_k) {
    k_penalty <- if (max_acceptable_k <= 1) 0 else k_penalty_weight * (best_k - 1) / (max_acceptable_k - 1)
  } else {
    excess_k <- best_k - max_acceptable_k
    k_penalty <- k_penalty_weight + (1 - k_penalty_weight) * (1 - exp(-excess_k))
  }
  k_penalty <- max(0, min(1, k_penalty))
  comp_score <- sep_score * (1 - k_penalty)

  list(
    percentage = pct,
    n_controls = n_ctrl,
    best_k = best_k,
    separation_score = sep_score,
    k_penalty = k_penalty,
    composite_score = comp_score,
    cancor_plot = cancor_p,
    ctl_idx = ctl_idx,
    control_genes = rownames(log_cpm_tmm)[ctl_idx]
  )
}) |> purrr::compact()

df_summary <- purrr::map_dfr(grid_results, function(r) {
  tibble::tibble(
    Percentage = r$percentage,
    Num_Controls = r$n_controls,
    Best_K = r$best_k,
    Separation_Score = round(r$separation_score, 4),
    K_Penalty = round(r$k_penalty, 4),
    Composite_Score = round(r$composite_score, 4)
  )
})

# Select best parameter set
best_idx <- which.max(purrr::map_dbl(grid_results, "composite_score"))
best_res <- grid_results[[best_idx]]
best_k <- best_res$best_k
best_control_genes <- best_res$control_genes

message(sprintf(
  "Optimal Mode: %d%% controls (n = %d), best_k = %d | Separation = %.4f, Composite = %.4f",
  best_res$percentage, best_res$n_controls, best_res$best_k,
  best_res$separation_score, best_res$composite_score
))
print(knitr::kable(df_summary, caption = "RUV Parameter Optimization Grid Results"))
```

# Publication Canonical Correlation Diagnostics

```{r plot-cca-diagnostics, fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
format_cancor_plot <- function(opt_res, panel_label = "A") {
  df <- opt_res$cancor_plot$data
  best_k_val <- opt_res$best_k
  best_pct_val <- opt_res$percentage
  n_ctrl_val <- opt_res$n_controls
  sep_val <- opt_res$separation_score
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = K, y = cc, color = featureset, group = featureset)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = best_k_val, linetype = "dashed", color = "#DC2626", linewidth = 0.8) +
    annotate("text",
      x = best_k_val + 0.15, y = 0.25,
      label = sprintf("Optimal k = %d\n(Separation = %.3f)", best_k_val, sep_val),
      hjust = 0, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold", color = "#DC2626"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("All" = "#2563EB", "Control" = "#10B981")) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(df$K)) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.05)) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    labs(
      title = sprintf("Panel %s: Canonical Correlation Analysis", panel_label),
      subtitle = sprintf("Tested %d%% negative controls (n = %d) selected via ANOVA/GLM", best_pct_val, n_ctrl_val),
      x = "Factor Dimensions (K)",
      y = expression(paste("Squared Canonical Correlation (", cancor^2, ")")),
      color = "Feature Set"
    ) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.position = "right")
}

format_tuning_curve <- function(summary_df, opt_res, panel_label = "B") {
  best_pct_val <- opt_res$percentage
  best_score_val <- opt_res$composite_score
  
  score_y <- min(summary_df$Composite_Score) + 0.85 * diff(range(summary_df$Composite_Score))
  text_x <- if (best_pct_val >= 20) best_pct_val - 1.5 else best_pct_val + 1.5
  text_hjust <- if (best_pct_val >= 20) 1 else 0
  
  ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = Percentage, y = Composite_Score)) +
    geom_line(color = "#475569", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(aes(color = factor(Best_K)), size = 3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = best_pct_val, linetype = "dashed", color = "#DC2626", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(data = summary_df[summary_df$Percentage == best_pct_val, ], color = "#DC2626", size = 4.5, shape = 18) +
    annotate("text",
      x = text_x, y = score_y,
      label = sprintf("Optimal: %d%% controls\nComposite Score = %.3f", best_pct_val, best_score_val),
      hjust = text_hjust, size = 3.2, fontface = "bold", color = "#DC2626"
    ) +
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = "Selected k") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = summary_df$Percentage) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    labs(
      title = sprintf("Panel %s: Control Percentage Optimization", panel_label),
      subtitle = "MultiScholaR Composite Score = Separation * (1 - k_penalty)",
      x = "Negative Controls Selected from Invariant Features (%)",
      y = "Composite Score"
    ) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.position = "right")
}

p_cca_a <- format_cancor_plot(best_res, "A")
p_cca_b <- format_tuning_curve(df_summary, best_res, "B")
grid_cca <- cowplot::plot_grid(p_cca_a, p_cca_b, ncol = 2, labels = NULL)

# Save multi-format exhibits
purrr::walk(c(".png", ".pdf"), ~{
  ggsave(file.path(publication_graphs_dir, paste0("canonical_correlation_panels", .x)),
         grid_cca, width = 12, height = 5, dpi = 300)
})

# Save workbook summary
wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, "Optimal_Parameters")
openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, "Grid_Optimization")
opt_summary_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
  Parameter = c("Optimal_K", "Optimal_Percentage", "Num_Negative_Controls", "Total_Features", "Separation_Score", "Composite_Score"),
  Value = c(best_res$best_k, best_res$percentage, best_res$n_controls, total_features, round(best_res$separation_score, 4), round(best_res$composite_score, 4))
)
openxlsx::writeData(wb, "Optimal_Parameters", opt_summary_tbl)
openxlsx::writeData(wb, "Grid_Optimization", df_summary)
openxlsx::saveWorkbook(wb, file.path(publication_graphs_dir, "canonical_correlation_optimization_summary.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
```

# RUVSeq Normalization (`RUVs`) & Covariate Estimation

We execute `RUVSeq::RUVs` with replicate difference structure to extract $k = `r best_k`$ unwanted variation terms ($W_1, \dots, W_k$).

```{r ruvs-normalization}
# Create SeqExpressionSet
set <- newSeqExpressionSet(
  counts = as.matrix(round(count_matrix_filtered)),
  phenoData = data.frame(design_matrix, row.names = design_matrix$Run)
)
differences <- makeGroups(design_matrix$group)

# Execute RUVs
set_ruvs <- RUVs(set, cIdx = best_control_genes, k = best_k, scIdx = differences)
ruvs_pdata <- pData(set_ruvs)

# Extract unwanted variation covariates W
w_columns <- paste0("W_", seq_len(best_k))
w_matrix <- ruvs_pdata[, w_columns, drop = FALSE]

# Batch-corrected logCPM for visualization diagnostics
design_groups_only <- model.matrix(~ group, data = ruvs_pdata)
log_cpm_corrected <- limma::removeBatchEffect(
  log_cpm_tmm,
  covariates = w_matrix,
  design = design_groups_only
)

# Export batch-adjusted matrix
vroom::vroom_write(
  as.data.frame(log_cpm_corrected) |> tibble::rownames_to_column("GeneID"),
  file.path(results_dir, "ruv_normalised_log_values.tsv")
)
cat("Extracted RUVs covariates:", paste(colnames(w_matrix), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

# Multi-Stage Diagnostic Comparison (Raw vs TMM vs RUVs)

```{r plot-norm-stages, fig.width=15, fig.height=9}
generateRlePlot <- function(mat, title, design_df, group_col = "group") {
  gene_medians <- apply(mat, 1, median)
  rle_matrix <- sweep(mat, 1, gene_medians, "-")
  rle_long <- as.data.frame(rle_matrix) |>
    rownames_to_column("gene") |>
    pivot_longer(cols = -gene, names_to = "Run", values_to = "rle_value") |>
    left_join(design_df, by = "Run")
  
  whisker_limits <- rle_long |>
    group_by(Run) |>
    summarise(
      q1 = quantile(rle_value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      q3 = quantile(rle_value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      iqr = q3 - q1,
      upper_whisker = q3 + 1.5 * iqr,
      lower_whisker = q1 - 1.5 * iqr,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  ylim_vals <- c(min(whisker_limits$lower_whisker), max(whisker_limits$upper_whisker))
  buffer <- (ylim_vals[2] - ylim_vals[1]) * 0.05
  ylim_vals <- c(ylim_vals[1] - buffer, ylim_vals[2] + buffer)
  
  ggplot(rle_long, aes(x = Run, y = rle_value, fill = .data[[group_col]])) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim_vals) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    labs(title = title, x = "Sample", y = "RLE", fill = "Group") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5))
}

generatePcaPlot <- function(mat, title, design_df, group_col = "group") {
  pca_res <- prcomp(t(mat))
  var_explained <- summary(pca_res)$importance[2, ] * 100
  pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca_res$x) |>
    rownames_to_column("Run") |>
    left_join(design_df, by = "Run")
  
  ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = .data[[group_col]])) +
    geom_point(size = 3.5) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = sprintf("PC1 (%.2f%%)", var_explained[1]),
      y = sprintf("PC2 (%.2f%%)", var_explained[2]),
      color = "Group"
    ) +
    theme_bw()
}

log_cpm_raw <- cpm(DGEList(counts = count_matrix_filtered), log = TRUE)

p_pca_raw <- generatePcaPlot(log_cpm_raw, "PCA: Raw logCPM", design_matrix)
p_pca_tmm <- generatePcaPlot(log_cpm_tmm, "PCA: After TMM", design_matrix)
p_pca_ruvs <- generatePcaPlot(log_cpm_corrected, sprintf("PCA: After RUVs (k=%d)", best_k), design_matrix)

p_rle_raw <- generateRlePlot(log_cpm_raw, "RLE: Raw logCPM", design_matrix)
p_rle_tmm <- generateRlePlot(log_cpm_tmm, "RLE: After TMM", design_matrix)
p_rle_ruvs <- generateRlePlot(log_cpm_corrected, sprintf("RLE: After RUVs (k=%d)", best_k), design_matrix)

final_norm_grid <- (p_pca_raw | p_pca_tmm | p_pca_ruvs) / (p_rle_raw | p_rle_tmm | p_rle_ruvs) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Comparison of Transcriptomics Normalization Stages",
    caption = "Top Row: PCA Plots. Bottom Row: RLE Plots."
  ) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

purrr::walk(c(".png", ".pdf"), ~{
  ggsave(file.path(publication_graphs_dir, paste0("normalization_comparison_grid", .x)),
         final_norm_grid, width = 15, height = 9, dpi = 300)
})

final_norm_grid
```

# Differential Expression Analysis with edgeR (Dynamic Model Update)

We dynamically update the edgeR generalized linear model to incorporate the exact number of estimated unwanted variation terms ($W_1, \dots, W_k$).

```{r edger-de-analysis}
# Prepare DGEList with RUVs factors
dge_final <- DGEList(counts = counts(set_ruvs), group = ruvs_pdata$group)
dge_final <- calcNormFactors(dge_final, method = "TMM")

# Dynamically construct linear model formula
w_terms <- colnames(ruvs_pdata)[stringr::str_starts(colnames(ruvs_pdata), "W_")]
design_formula_str <- paste("~ 0 + group", paste(w_terms, collapse = " + "), sep = " + ")
cat("Dynamically updated linear model formula:", design_formula_str, "\n")

design_final <- model.matrix(as.formula(design_formula_str), data = ruvs_pdata)
colnames(design_final) <- make.names(colnames(design_final))

# Fit Quasi-Likelihood negative binomial generalized linear model
dge_final <- estimateDisp(dge_final, design_final, robust = TRUE)
fit_final <- glmQLFit(dge_final, design_final, robust = TRUE)

# Parse contrast specification from contrast_strings.tab
contrast_file <- file.path(source_dir, "contrast_strings.tab")
contrast_lines <- readLines(contrast_file)
contrast_entry <- contrast_lines[!grepl("^contrast", contrast_lines) & nzchar(contrast_lines)][1]
contrast_parts <- strsplit(contrast_entry, "=")[[1]]
contrast_name <- trimws(contrast_parts[1])
contrast_expr <- trimws(contrast_parts[2])

contrasts_matrix <- makeContrasts(contrasts = contrast_expr, levels = design_final)
colnames(contrasts_matrix) <- contrast_name
cat("Design matrix levels:\n", paste(colnames(design_final), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Evaluated Contrast Matrix:\n")
print(contrasts_matrix)

# Run QL F-test
lrt <- glmQLFTest(fit_final, contrast = contrasts_matrix[, contrast_name])
top_genes <- topTags(lrt, n = Inf, sort.by = "PValue")$table

# Merge gene annotation metadata
top_genes_annotated <- top_genes |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("GeneID") |>
  dplyr::left_join(feature_meta, by = "GeneID") |>
  dplyr::mutate(DisplaySymbol = ifelse(!is.na(GeneName) & GeneName != "", GeneName, GeneID)) |>
  dplyr::relocate(GeneID, GeneName, DisplaySymbol)

# Save full DE output
de_results_file <- file.path(de_output_dir, paste0("de_results_", contrast_name, ".csv"))
write.csv(top_genes_annotated, de_results_file, row.names = FALSE)

# Extract top 10 upregulated and top 10 downregulated genes
top_up <- top_genes_annotated |>
  filter(FDR < 0.05, logFC > 0) |>
  arrange(FDR) |>
  head(10) |>
  mutate(regulation = "Upregulated")

top_down <- top_genes_annotated |>
  filter(FDR < 0.05, logFC < 0) |>
  arrange(FDR) |>
  head(10) |>
  mutate(regulation = "Downregulated")

top_de_combined <- bind_rows(top_up, top_down) |>
  mutate(comparison = contrast_name)
vroom::vroom_write(top_de_combined, file.path(de_output_dir, "top_de_genes.tsv"))

cat(sprintf("DE testing complete: %d genes differentially expressed at FDR < 0.05 (%d up, %d down).\n",
            sum(top_genes_annotated$FDR < 0.05),
            sum(top_genes_annotated$FDR < 0.05 & top_genes_annotated$logFC > 0),
            sum(top_genes_annotated$FDR < 0.05 & top_genes_annotated$logFC < 0)))
print(knitr::kable(head(top_de_combined, 10), caption = "Top Significant Differentially Expressed Genes"))
```

# Publication Volcano & Summary Bar Plots

```{r plot-volcano-summary, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
generateVolcanoPlot <- function(de_df, title, fdr_thresh = 0.05, top_n = 20) {
  df <- de_df |>
    mutate(
      significance = case_when(
        FDR < fdr_thresh & logFC > 0 ~ "Upregulated",
        FDR < fdr_thresh & logFC < 0 ~ "Downregulated",
        TRUE ~ "Not Significant"
      ),
      significance = factor(significance, levels = c("Upregulated", "Downregulated", "Not Significant"))
    )
  
  labels_df <- df |>
    filter(significance != "Not Significant") |>
    arrange(FDR) |>
    head(top_n)
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(FDR), color = significance)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.6) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Upregulated" = "#EF4444", "Downregulated" = "#3B82F6", "Not Significant" = "#9CA3AF")) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(fdr_thresh), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dotted", color = "grey40") +
    geom_text_repel(data = labels_df, aes(label = DisplaySymbol), size = 3.2, max.overlaps = 25) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Volcano Plot:", title),
      subtitle = sprintf("Highlighted top %d significant genes by FDR", nrow(labels_df)),
      x = expression(Log[2]~Fold~Change),
      y = expression(-Log[10]~(FDR)),
      color = "Significance"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

generateBarPlot <- function(de_df, title, fdr_thresh = 0.05) {
  df <- de_df |>
    mutate(
      significance = case_when(
        FDR < fdr_thresh & logFC > 0 ~ "Upregulated",
        FDR < fdr_thresh & logFC < 0 ~ "Downregulated",
        TRUE ~ "Not Significant"
      ),
      significance = factor(significance, levels = c("Upregulated", "Downregulated", "Not Significant"))
    ) |>
    count(significance, .drop = FALSE)
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = significance, y = n, fill = significance)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.55) +
    geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.5, fontface = "bold", size = 3.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Upregulated" = "#EF4444", "Downregulated" = "#3B82F6", "Not Significant" = "#9CA3AF")) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Significance Summary:", title),
      x = "Class",
      y = "Gene Count"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}

volcano_p <- generateVolcanoPlot(top_genes_annotated, contrast_name)
bar_p <- generateBarPlot(top_genes_annotated, contrast_name)

# Export graphics in both PDF and PNG
purrr::walk(c(".png", ".pdf"), ~{
  ggsave(file.path(publication_graphs_dir, "Volcano_Plots", paste0("volcano_plot_", contrast_name, .x)),
         volcano_p, width = 8, height = 7, dpi = 300)
  ggsave(file.path(publication_graphs_dir, "NumSigDeMolecules", paste0("summary_barplot_", contrast_name, .x)),
         bar_p, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
})

cowplot::plot_grid(volcano_p, bar_p, rel_widths = c(1.3, 0.7))
```

```{r glimma-volcano, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
glimma_anno <- top_genes_annotated |>

  )
  cat("Interactive Glimma volcano HTML report saved to:\n", glimma_html_path, "\n")
}, error = function(e) {
  warning("Glimma generation warning: ", e$message)
})
```

# RUVIII Normalization for Multi-Omics Factor Analysis (MOFA Integration)

To support downstream cross-omics integration (e.g. MOFA2, DIABLO), this section runs `ruv::RUVIII` to generate a batch-adjusted expression matrix where technical replicate variation is explicitly removed.

```{r ruviii-mofa-normalization, fig.width=11, fig.height=8}
# 1. Biological replicate structure matrix M
M <- ruv::replicate.matrix(as.character(design_matrix$group))

# 2. Control features indicator mask
ctl_mask <- rep(FALSE, nrow(log_cpm_tmm))
ctl_mask[rownames(log_cpm_tmm) %in% best_control_genes] <- TRUE

# 3. Fit RUVIII model
res_ruviii <- ruv::RUVIII(Y = t(log_cpm_tmm), M = M, ctl = ctl_mask, k = best_k, return.info = TRUE)
rnaseq_ruv_mat <- res_ruviii$newY

# 4. Format normalized matrix with Run identifier
rnaseq_sample_vs_rna_cln <- rnaseq_ruv_mat |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Run")

# 5. Export normalized data to standard transcriptomics results and MOFA input paths
mofa_export_path_1 <- file.path(results_dir, "transcriptomics_normalized_data.tsv")
mofa_export_path_2 <- file.path(base_dir, "results", "Transcriptomics", "transcriptomics_normalized_data.tsv")

vroom::vroom_write(rnaseq_sample_vs_rna_cln, mofa_export_path_1)
vroom::vroom_write(rnaseq_sample_vs_rna_cln, mofa_export_path_2)

cat("RUVIII batch-adjusted normalized matrix exported for MOFA:\n")
cat(" - Primary:", mofa_export_path_1, "\n")
cat(" - Workshop Shared:", mofa_export_path_2, "\n")

# 6. Pre vs Post RUVIII comparison diagnostics
p_pca_post_ruviii <- generatePcaPlot(t(rnaseq_ruv_mat), "PCA: After RUVIII Normalization", design_matrix)
p_rle_post_ruviii <- generateRlePlot(t(rnaseq_ruv_mat), "RLE: After RUVIII Normalization", design_matrix)

ruviii_comparison_grid <- (p_pca_tmm | p_pca_post_ruviii) / (p_rle_tmm | p_rle_post_ruviii) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Pre vs Post RUVIII Normalization Diagnostics",
    caption = "Left: After TMM (Pre-RUVIII). Right: After RUVIII."
  ) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

purrr::walk(c(".png", ".pdf"), ~{
  ggsave(file.path(publication_graphs_dir, paste0("ruviii_before_and_after", .x)),
         ruviii_comparison_grid, width = 11, height = 8, dpi = 300)
})

ruviii_comparison_grid
```
